h1: Stocking Stuffers for Teen Boys: Tech, Games and Gear
intro: Twenty small things for the boy whose wish list is one link long. Real earbuds, a power bank that lasts a tournament day, a football that grips in the cold, and a stack of card games that get a table of teenagers off their phones. Everything here is under twenty five dollars and checked on the listing, and all of it is built to survive a backpack.
seo_title: Stocking Stuffers for Teen Boys Under $25: Tech and Games
seo_description: Twenty stocking stuffers for teen boys under $25, from earbuds and a power bank to card games and a football. Verified editor picks from Evergreen House.
list_card_line: Twenty things for a teen boy's stocking, all under $25: earbuds, gear and the card games that actually get played.

cards.B0CXG87GYK: Real wireless earbuds at fifteen dollars, so losing one in a backpack is not a family crisis.
cards.B0012SNLJG: A composite football with a grip that holds in the cold, for the kid who plays until the light goes.
cards.B07R5XQRLD: A charging cable on a keychain, for the kid whose phone dies exactly when he needs a ride home.
cards.B01MAUIT05: Merry cherry cotton candy with a name he will read out loud, and it is honestly good candy.
cards.B009Z2WXA4: Eye black stickers he can letter with his own number, for game day and every photo after it.
cards.B09ZKHRP2N: Cooling arm sleeves for long practices, sun protection that does not feel like another layer.
cards.B08XYP223R: Two pairs of gaming socks with old console controllers on them, a joke he will wear anyway.
cards.B0DZJM5VPY: Four lip balms that live in a coat, a bag, a desk and a locker, so one is always within reach.
cards.B0991KSWN9: Strip lights that take his room from homework to game night with one word to the speaker.
cards.B00D7H9LIA: Ten pairs of hand warmers for the sideline, the bus stop and the walk home after practice.
cards.B0D51F42SW: A five in one card game that fits in a pocket and settles a rainy afternoon in ten minutes.
cards.B079D7XHSY: A handheld puzzle that keeps his hands busy in the car, quietly, which is the whole point.
cards.B0CJLT4R9G: A card game built on impossible questions, the fastest way to get a quiet group talking.
cards.B0CBT2N7N1: The meanest version of UNO, in a tin, for the kid who plays to win and is not shy about it.
cards.B00NQQTZCO: Monopoly in fifteen minutes with no board to lose, so it comes out on every single trip.
cards.B092W7D64G: The original cube, still the best thing to hand a kid who needs a break from a screen.
cards.B0D9C251D4: A card game in a tin with absurd rules and short rounds, which is how games actually get played.
cards.B0CZ9M6X8Q: Enough charge for two full days out, so the phone survives a tournament or a long bus ride.
cards.B00THLMIHG: A logic puzzle with hundreds of challenges, and the rare toy that keeps him quiet and proud.
cards.B077Z1R28P: A fast, silly card game that gets a table of teenagers laughing in under a minute.
